_source: docs/Prd/lynkeduppro_contact_workflow_studio (1).html — the :root block of the approved mockup, which is the binding UI contract rather than a reference.
_contract: THIS FILE IS THE ONE SOURCE. tailwind.config.js reads it to build the theme, scripts/build-tokens.mjs emits src/styles/tokens.generated.css from it, and design-system/tokens.ts wraps it for typed use in components. Nothing else may declare a raw colour. Editing a value here changes every consumer at once, which is the whole point — the previous arrangement kept the Tailwind theme and the CSS custom properties as two hand-maintained copies, and they had already drifted (--white, --cond, --sans and --mono existed in the mockup and in Tailwind but were missing from the CSS mirror).

color._borders: line is the default divider; line2 is the raised/hover state
color._type: text is body copy; muted is secondary; soft is the faintest legible tier
color._accents: meaning is assigned in the semantic map, never picked ad hoc

_scale_note: The mockup is a dense studio view authored at roughly half the density of the shipped app, so its literal 8–11px sizes are NOT ported as-is — they would fail WCAG target and legibility floors in a full-page layout. The RATIOS are ported: a five-step type scale and the radius family the mockup actually uses (6/8/10/11/12/14/17/99), rounded to the values that appear more than once.
_meaning_note: The maps below live in the JSON rather than in tokens.ts on purpose: the Tailwind config and the CSS/safelist generator are plain JS and cannot read a .ts module, so putting meaning in TypeScript would have split the source in two again — the exact failure this file exists to end. tokens.ts imports these and adds types and helpers, nothing more.

identity.means: identity, navigation, primary action, active selection

success.means: eligible, within SLA, consented, verified, won

warning.means: approaching breach, awaiting review, candidate, pending evidence

publicRecord.means: public-record provenance, AI-assisted pending human review

brand.means: brand accent — marketing surfaces only, never a status

_origin_note: Eight origin classes collapse onto four trust tiers deliberately. What an operator must see at a glance is how far to trust the record; one hue per class would look precise and say nothing.
_trust_note: Ordered, not categorical: the ladder climbs from captured-and-unexamined to directly-verified, so the colours climb with it.
_source_note: Presentational only. The surface a capture arrived on says nothing about how far to trust it, so these carry no status meaning and resolve to a bare fill.
_contrast_note: Which text tiers must stay legible on which surfaces. Asserted, not assumed — tests/unit/designTokens.test.ts computes the WCAG 2.2 ratio for every pair below and fails the build if one drops under AA. Accents are checked as large/bold text (3:1), which is how the mockup uses them: chip labels and numerals, never body copy.
